title: In-Context Inpainting for Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2608.23855v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose ICI-Time, a novel framework that reframes time series forecasting as a visual inpainting task, leveraging the generalisation power of large vision models (LVMs). Unlike methods that require specialised temporal architectures and extensive domain-specific training, ICI-Time transforms time series into structured visual representations (area charts) and applies visual in-context learning, reformulating forecasting as pattern completion within a grid-structured prompt that pre-trained vision transformers can solve without fine-tuning or architectural modification. Temporal dependencies are represented through spatial layout, with a consistent, invertible mapping between numerical and visual domains. translated_title: 时间序列预测的上下文内修复方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23855v1 公告类型：新  摘要：我们提出了ICI-Time，一个新颖的框架，将时间序列预测重新定义为视觉修复任务，利用大型视觉模型（LVMs）的泛化能力。与需要专门时间架构和大量领域特定训练的方法不同，ICI-Time将时间序列转换为结构化视觉表示（面积图），并应用视觉上下文学习，将预测重新表述为网格结构提示中的模式完成，预训练的视觉变换器无需微调或架构修改即可解决。时间依赖关系通过空间布局表示，数值和视觉域之间具有一致、可逆的映射。在流行病学、气象学和电力系统中的广泛实验表明，ICI-Time与深度学习基线相比具有竞争力，并在数据有限的设置下展现出有前景的适应性，引入了一种新的方法。
tldr: ICI-Time通过将时间序列转换为面积图并利用预训练视觉模型的上下文学习能力，无需微调即可完成预测，在多种领域数据中展现出与深度学习基线相当的性能和少样本适应性。
en_tdlr: ICI-Time reframes time series forecasting as visual inpainting by converting data into area charts and leveraging pre-trained vision models' in-context learning, achieving competitive performance and few-shot adaptability without fine-tuning.
